status: DEVELOPMENT — authored before any vocabulary change, by the session that builds it. Not held-out evidence.
purpose: Same subject, different word forms: morphology (blocker/blocking, shipping/ship, manager/managing, renewal/renew), acronyms (TA, PM, CEO), and different wording with the same meaning (expected to stay unsolved by deterministic matching — measured as a gap). Every positive rule has negative controls: look-alike words that must NOT be pulled in (blockchain, relationship, numbing/number, tax/take vs TA, us vs US, later vs late, a colliding acronym expansion).
